title: Maximum Width of Binary Tree
constraints: The maximum width fits in a signed 32-bit integer.
inputFormat:
Implement maximumWidthOfBinaryTree(root). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: Return the maximum number of complete-tree positions from the leftmost to rightmost real node on one level, inclusive. Count gaps between them.
